profile.headline: Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Microsoft

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Individual contributor to a variety of high visibility UX surfaces on the Windows Desktop and other undisclosed operating systems. 
•	Pioneered Xaml based UX implementation for the CoreUX team. Migrated Task View (also known as Win+Tab) UX surface from DComposition to Xaml.
•	Designed, developed, and documented UserInteractionMode public API.
•	Experience in several rendering technologies and frameworks – including DirectComposition and GDI.
•	Developed a suite of automated MTBF tests designed to test stress and reliability of Windows in conformance with requirements from multiple cellular operators.

positions.title: Student Manager - Student Technology Services
positions.description: Worked as a technician to provide assistance for customers with software problems, hardware issues, and virus trouble. Interacted with 50+ customers on a daily basis.

positions.title: Student Technology Services - Student Technology Coordinator
positions.description: Resolved computer issues for customers, maintained computer labs, and assisted with other technology related problems. Created, organized and presented technology educating programs to target audience of 300 students.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Designed and developed an immersive application prototyping features for future versions of Windows. Created a custom Windows API to expose functionality and interact with said application

positions.title: Computer Science Intern - Client & Patient Systems
positions.description: Responsibilities included a mix of technology consulting and mobile app development. Assisted in development of iOS app, as well as contributing to planning and implementing process automation measures to increase organization efficiency.
